rows: Shut down the unit completely and coordinate with the operations department to implement the required precautions recorded in the work order for the unit No. (2) gas air heater, following the safety instructions for isolating the air heater
Verify that the air heater temperature has reached the suitable temperature to start work, namely 60 °C

Chemically wash the gas air heater before starting work, using a chemical solution at a temperature suitable for the air heater temperature to avoid thermal stresses on the air heater metal during washing

Open the inspection door at the top of the air heater below the stack, then enter the air heater above the cold-zone basket sector and empty the baskets of one of the sheet-metal sectors to allow inspection of both ends of the sector
Inspect the expansion joints for absence of corrosion inside the air heater parts in this area
Erect a scaffold below the hot sheet inside the air heater to inspect the air heater body and the expansion joints
Inspect the air heater clearances and the flexible connections and verify they are fit for service

On inspection, corrosion was found to have started in the following places: Cold side radial seal sector, consisting of two sectors and a middle part around the shaft; the corrosion is at the ends, the middle area and the other side of the sector, and the thickness has begun to fall below 10 mm, indicating that it cannot continue in service for another 6 months, so it must be replaced with a new one
The complete radial seal sector was replaced

When dismantling the side parts (Seal air frame) responsible for the (Axial seal), the following was done: - Replace the axial seal jacket - Adjust the axial clearances on both sides - The tie rods and the air heater expansion joints were changed after completion of the previous work
Parts of the cold side cover grates were manufactured and designed under the supervision of the boiler maintenance department at the station workshops
Expansion joints were fitted for the gas passage below the gas air heater in place of the damaged parts

After completing the air heater work and adjusting the permitted clearance values, a run test of the gas air heater was carried out to verify the normal operating conditions of the air heater before putting it into actual service
